biocs.name: Uncommon LOLBin Execution by Scheduled Task
biocs.description: Detection of mshta.exe being executed by a scheduled task with a remote URL argument
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mshta.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'schtasks.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'http://'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
